findings.quote: Despite this significant heating load, the fabric was not ignited.
findings.about: Nomex fabric (sample 2-7) was not ignited by the burning PMMA ahead of it

findings.quote: It took about two minutes for the PMMA to be consumed, all the while the flame plume was extending over and heating the base of the Nomex® fabric.
findings.about: Sample 2-7: the PMMA lead-in burned for about two minutes

findings.quote: The average flame power from the PMMA (assuming complete conversion of the fuel) was 460 + 50 W.
findings.about: Sample 2-7: average flame power of the PMMA, 460 + 50 W as printed (no site variable)

findings.quote: Nomex®, a common material used on the ISS and rated “safe,” could not be ignited even when bathed by a pilot flame.
findings.about: Nomex could not be ignited in orbit

findings.quote: ii The PMMA portion was completely consumed but the Nomex was not ignited.
findings.about: Sample 2-7: the PMMA was consumed, the Nomex not ignited

findings.quote: Initial oxygen concentration 22.1% (ISS reading, slightly higher than Saffire-1’s 21.7%)
findings.about: Saffire-II starting oxygen, as read on the ISS

findings.quote: All upward burns except Sample 2-4 was downward
findings.about: Saffire-II: all burns upward (concurrent) except 2-4, downward (opposed)
